        **Posted on:** October 08, 2026

        About the Role

Elevate Now is looking for a Growth Product Manager to own the acquisition and activation funnel for our digital health and pharmacy offerings. You will drive efficient, scalable user growth through data-driven experimentation, channel strategy, and conversion optimization across the journey from first touch to repeat purchase and monetization.

In e-pharmacy, growth depends on trust, compliance, and repeat behavior, not just clicks. We want someone who understands how patients discover medicines, upload prescriptions, reorder chronic therapies, and decide where to buy, and who can turn that understanding into measurable funnel gains.

Requirements

What You Will Do
Own acquisition and activation metrics. Analyze conversion, CLV, repeat order rate, and churn to prioritize high-ROI growth bets.
Design and run A/B tests across landing pages, app and web onboarding, prescription upload, cart and checkout, pricing and discounting, and subscription or refill flows to improve conversion and reduce friction.
Optimize the first-order journey: search or catalog browse, Rx upload and validation, pharmacist verification, order placement, and delivery. Identify and fix drop-offs at every step.
Build and scale growth loops, including SEO and SEM for medicine and condition-led demand, referral programs, refill reminders and chronic-care retention loops, and partnerships with clinics, diagnostics, insurers, and corporate wellness programs.
Work with performance marketing and CRM teams on channel strategy, CAC efficiency, and lifecycle campaigns (WhatsApp, push, SMS, email).
Instrument event tracking and build self-serve dashboards covering visit to signup, signup to first order, first to second order, and CAC payback.
Translate insights into clear PRDs and ship iteratively with design, engineering, data, and pharmacy operations.
Partner with compliance, pharmacy, and operations teams so growth experiments respect regulatory requirements around prescription medicines, promotions, and data privacy.
Communicate experiment results, learnings, and next steps clearly to stakeholders.
What We Are Looking For

Must have

2 to 3 years in product or growth, with a track record of experiments that moved core funnel metrics in B2C or B2B2C settings.
Hands-on experience at an e-pharmacy, online healthcare, or pharmacy marketplace platform (for example in acquisition, onboarding, ordering, or retention).
Working SQL for cohort analysis, funnel deep-dives, event and query design, and experiment readouts.
Comfort with GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar tools, and strong spreadsheet skills.
Hypothesis-driven thinking, sound prioritization, and strong cross-functional collaboration.
Familiarity with PLG and growth metrics such as CVR, CAC, LTV/CAC, payback period, and retention.

Good to have

Experience with chronic medication refill, subscription, or adherence journeys.
Understanding of prescription-driven demand, pharmacist workflows, and OTC versus Rx purchase behavior.
Experience with SEO for health and pharmacy content, app store optimization, or marketplace and aggregator channels.
Exposure to healthcare regulations and advertising norms for pharmacy in India.
Success Metrics
Uplift in conversion at key steps: visit to signup, signup to activation (first Rx upload or first order), and trial or first order to repeat order.
Lower CAC and shorter CAC payback.
Improved LTV/CAC.
Higher 30, 60, and 90-day repeat order rate and refill retention.
Why Join Elevate Now
Own a high-impact growth charter with direct visibility into business outcomes.
Work at the intersection of healthcare, product, and data, where growth improves access to medicines for real patients.
Collaborate closely with leadership, engineering, and operations in a fast-moving team.
title: Product Manager - Growth

        Build the product engine behind the next generation of MedTech software.

REMATIQ is building AI software that helps life sciences and medical device companies bring products to market faster, without compromising the quality, traceability and compliance their industry demands.

We work with leading companies including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun and Novartis, and have recently closed our Series A.

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.

Now we’re looking for a hands-on Product Lead / Head of Product to help us turn ambitious product direction into exceptional shipped product.

The role

This is a player-coach role for someone who wants real product ownership without moving away from the product itself.

Our founder will continue to lead long-term product strategy, major capability bets and the frontier of where REMATIQ should go.

You will own how we get there.

You’ll take responsibility for the full product execution loop:

Customer insight product ideas prioritization definition engineering refinement sprint execution shipped product learning.

You’ll lead a growing team of 2–3 Product Managers, raise the quality bar across the product organization, and still directly own one or two of our most important and complex product areas yourself.

You won’t be managing the process from the sidelines. You’ll be in the details with customers, PMs, engineers and designers, making decisions and helping the team ship.

What you’ll do

Own product execution end to end: Turn strategic direction and customer insight into clear priorities, well-defined product work and shipped outcomes.

Lead and develop the Product team: Manage 2–3 PMs, help them sharpen their judgment and execution, and establish a consistently high bar for product work.

Stay hands-on: Personally lead discovery, define product requirements, make prioritization decisions and own some of our hardest product areas.

Run product across multiple squads: Create clarity across Product, Engineering and Design and ensure teams move from idea to execution without unnecessary process or ambiguity.

Make the hard calls: Navigate competing customer needs, technical constraints and incomplete information, and make clear product decisions rather than simply facilitating consensus.

Build an AI-native product organization: Use AI deeply in your own work and help rethink how discovery, specification, prototyping, analysis and product development should work in an AI-first company.

Stay close to customers: Understand how sophisticated enterprise teams actually work, identify the problems worth solving and turn customer insight into scalable product rather than one-off features.

Continuously improve how we build: Identify where our product process needs more structure, where it needs less, and build the operating rhythm that helps REMATIQ ship better and faster as we scale.

What we're looking for

You may be a strong fit if you:

Have led product for a B2B enterprise software product.

Have directly managed at least 2 Product Managers.

Are still deeply hands-on and comfortable running discovery, writing and refining product requirements, prioritizing trade-offs and working closely with Engineering.

Have owned product delivery across multiple squads or product areas.

Have strong product judgment and are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

Are genuinely AI-forward: you actively use AI in your work, understand how it changes product development, and have thoughtful views on what makes a product truly AI-native.

Communicate exceptionally well, both in writing and in conversation.

Operate with high ownership, pace and reliability.

We'll be especially excited if you

Have been a founder, founding PM or very early product leader and can demonstrate founder-like ownership.

Are technically strong enough to work deeply with engineers on APIs, data, AI systems, workflows and technical trade-offs.

Learned product craft inside an excellent product organization with a high bar for execution.

Have experienced both sides of the journey: building product in an early-stage environment and later helping a product organization scale.

Why REMATIQ?

A rare product moment: We have enterprise customers, strong demand and fresh Series A funding, while many of the product systems and ways of working for our next stage are still yours to shape.

Real product ownership: You'll have genuine authority over prioritization, product definition and execution, while staying close enough to the work to personally influence what gets built.

Player-coach by design: This isn't a role where leadership means leaving product craft behind. You'll build the team while continuing to own meaningful product problems yourself.

AI is the product and the way we work: You'll help define what an AI-native product organization should actually look like, rather than simply adding AI tools to traditional processes.

Complex problems worth solving: Our customers operate in environments where workflows are technical, regulated and mission-critical. The product challenges are correspondingly deep.

Work directly with the people shaping the company: Partner closely with the founders, Engineering and Design on the decisions that determine what REMATIQ becomes.

Meaningful impact: Better software can help medical innovators reduce manual work, navigate complexity and bring important products to market faster and more safely.

Compensation and ownership: Competitive salary plus equity, giving you a meaningful stake in the company you're helping to build.
title: Product Lead

Daarbij creëer je draagvlak voor keuzes en helpt de organisatie focus aan te brengen op de initiatieven die de meeste waarde opleveren.

Jouw werk als Product Owner bestaat uit:

Het vertalen van doelen en inzichten naar een transparante roadmap waarbij je duidelijke keuzes maakt over wat we wel én niet doen. Je zorgt hier ook voor helderheid over de beoogde uitkomst en waarde, en communiceert open over gemaakte keuzes, voortgang, risico's en resultaten;
Het bouwen aan sterke relaties met interne- en externe stakeholders en brengt belangen, inzichten en prioriteiten samen;
Product discovery, waarbij je samen met gebruikers, data-experts, designers en developers onderzoekt waar de grootste kansen en knelpunten liggen;
Het beheren en prioriteren van de product backlog en ondersteunen van het delivery process. Daarbij weeg je kwaliteit, veiligheid en privacy bewust mee in productkeuzes;
Het meten van het effect van wat we opleveren en gebruiken van data en gebruikersinzichten om verder te verbeteren.

Wil jij een indruk krijgen van de innoverende zorg die Ksyos ontwikkelt? Bekijk hieronder de video over Ksyos.

Ksyos & jouw team

Bij Ksyos geloven we dat toegankelijke en hoogwaardige zorg relevant is voor iedereen in Nederland. Ons platform verbindt huisartsen, medisch specialisten, paramedici en patiënten. Via Ksyos kunnen huisartsen laagdrempelig een specialist raadplegen en worden patiënten dichtbij huis gediagnosticeerd en behandeld. Onze focus ligt de komende jaren op vijf zorgdomeinen: cardiologie, slaap, GGZ, oogheelkunde en obesitas. Binnen deze domeinen bouwen we met zo'n 160 toegewijde collega's aan complete digitale zorgpaden, van verwijzing tot diagnose en behandeling. Daarbij benutten we de zorgdata die door de hele zorgketen heen beschikbaar komt.

Als Product Owner ben je onderdeel van het PO-team (totaal 4 POs) binnen de afdeling Design & Tech en rapporteer je aan de Lead Product Owner. Je voert je dagelijkse werk uit in een cross-functioneel scrum team waar designers, software developers en een software tester onderdeel van zijn. Waar jij eigenaarschap draagt van het digitale product en de afstemming binnen jouw scrum team, werk je ook nauw samen met onze productspecialisten die eigenaar zijn van de zorginhoud, markbehoefte en businessdoelstellingen binnen één specifiek vakgebied binnen Ksyos. Gezamenlijk verbeteren jullie ons digitale zorgplatform en de digitale zorgervaring van patiënten, zorgverleners en verwijzers.

Binnen Design & Tech geloven we dat de beste resultaten ontstaan wanneer verschillende disciplines hun expertise combineren. Product brengt richting en prioriteit, Design zorgt voor een uitstekende gebruikerservaring en Tech voor een schaalbaar en betrouwbaar platform. Samen werken we aan oplossingen die waarde toevoegen voor gebruikers én bijdragen aan de doelen van Ksyos.

Jij bent

Je bent een nieuwsgierige en analytische Product Owner die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen gebruikers, stakeholders en ontwikkelteams. Je begrijpt dat goede productontwikkeling niet alleen gaat over functies bouwen, maar vooral over het maken van de juiste keuzes. En jij weet met jouw stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden verschillende belangen samen te brengen.

Jij hebt als Product Owner bij Ksyos:

Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Product Owner, Product Manager of in een vergelijkbare productrol binnen een (agile) softwareomgeving;
Aantoonbare ervaring met stakeholdermanagement in een complexe omgeving, waarbij je keuzes communicatief sterk en organisatiesensitief onderbouwt met data, gebruikersinzichten en bedrijfswaarde;
Ervaring in product discovery, bent doortastend en weet wat ervoor nodig is om snel en slim input op te halen om aannames en hypotheses te testen;
Een hoog verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en bent gedreven waardoor je zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen en je anderen aanspreekt wanneer nodig om resultaat te behalen;
Een vloeiende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, dit is nodig voor het optimaal functioneren binnen Ksyos, dit scrumteam en onze zorgomgeving.

Affiniteit met de zorg is een mooie pre. Daarnaast werk je dagelijks samen met developers, designers en tech leads. Je hoeft niet zelf de technische oplossingen te ontwerpen, maar begrijpt voldoende van softwareontwikkeling om effectieve afwegingen te maken en gezamenlijk tot de beste resultaten te komen.

Jij krijgt

Ksyos is een dynamische, groeiende organisatie. Binnen Ksyos kun je écht impact maken, jouw mening wordt gehoord. Ook word je uitgedaagd om beter te worden en continu de juiste keuzes te maken, op het juiste moment. Verandering is de enige constante factor bij Ksyos en hierdoor ontwikkel je snel. Daarnaast zijn jouw toegewijde, gedreven collega's door de hele organisatie altijd bereid om te helpen.

Jij krijgt voor jouw inzet als Product Owner bij Ksyos*:

Een goed salaris tussen de €4.500,- en €6.500,- bruto per maand (o.b.v. fulltime), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;
Als eerst een tijdelijk contract, waarbij wij streven naar een duurzaam dienstverband;
De mogelijkheid om fulltime (40 uur) of parttime (32 / 36 uur) te werken;
Ruimte voor jouw inbreng en ideeën;
Keuze uit een Windows/Apple laptop om jouw werkzaamheden goed te kunnen verrichten;
Toegewijde collega's die altijd bereid zijn om te helpen.

Solliciteer

Ben jij klaar om deel uit te maken van ons gedreven team bij Ksyos en jouw stempel te drukken op de gezondheidszorg in Nederland? Solliciteer als Product Owner met jouw CV en motivatiebrief.
